summary: No Tekirdağ-specific statute, enforcement action, incident or institution concerning transgender visitors appears in the source inventory, so the national assessment carried on Turkey's record applies to the province.
tangentialFactors:
Enforcement recorded in the inventory sits in other provinces: the June 2025 blanket bans on the LGBTI and Trans pride marches in Istanbul, the remand of three activists under the public-assemblies law with prosecutions of 92 people continuing at year's end, and the İzmir court's December 2025 order dissolving the Young LGBTI+ Association. No comparable action in Tekirdağ appears in the sources, and the inventory carries no provincial-level reporting either way.

Tekirdağ stands under Turkey's national framework. The public-assemblies law that governs the assembly bans and prosecutions recorded in the inventory binds authorities in Tekirdağ as it does across the country. The inventory's remaining national material, covering gender recognition, military service, anti-discrimination law, partnership recognition and the 2026 judicial reform package, is carried on Turkey's record and is not restated here.
localsOnly: The inventory records no provincial measure directed at transgender residents of Tekirdağ. Residents fall under the same national regime as the rest of Turkey.
outOfScopeNotes: No provincial breakdown accompanies the national violation statistics in the inventory, so the share of the national totals attributable to Tekirdağ is not sourced. Whether the provincial governor has issued any assembly ban or permit refusal in Tekirdağ is likewise unrecorded.
